title: Speech input: the person's Soniox key and one dictation's temporary key
$comment: Errors are the common envelope with fixed codes: speech_key_missing (409, no key in the home), speech_key_rejected (409, Soniox refused the key in every region), speech_limit_reached (429, Soniox's or the daemon's limit), speech_unavailable (503, Soniox did not answer). A key update answers the last three too: it is saved only once Soniox has taken it, with the region it took it in. Nothing Soniox said crosses.

key_update.$comment: No region: the daemon finds the one Soniox takes the key in.

session.$comment: The one provider token that crosses the contract (internal/AGENTS.md): single-use, opens a stream for at most 60 s, transcribe_websocket only, the session capped at max_session_seconds.
